messages:
deploybot: Starting migration window for schema 'user_preferences_v2' on prod-db-01. Canary 10% -> holdpoint at canary. Window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Plan: apply DDL, then run backfill job user_pref_fill (sharded). Rollback plan in runbook: https://runbook.internal/mig-userprefs

deploybot: Run command:
```
redwood deploy migrate --env=prod --db=prod-db-01 --schema=user_preferences_v2 --canary=0.10 --holdpoint=true
```

sam: ack — I'm on-call for the window, will watch locks/latency.

elaine: Drafted release notes and pinned API client to 2.14.3 in release-notes channel. Migration tag: release-2026-03-21.

mike: saw lock spikes last night at 12% canary. can we reduce to 5% to be safe? :thinking_face:

elaine: yep. updating deploy parameters now — will set canary to 5%. use `--canary=0.05`

deploybot: Canary parameter updated to 5%. Applying migration to 5% shard set. Holdpoint will wait for manual / automatic check. Backfill job queued: job_id=ufb-20260321-09.

laura: backfill started on shards [4,7] (5% traffic). progress: 8% rows processed. ETA ~45m. posting logs to ops channel.

ops-bot: observability: pg_locks metric on prod-db-01 increased +45% vs baseline (threshold 30%). current CPU 62%, p99 latency 120ms. See: https://metrics.internal/prod-db-01/locks

sam: if locks breach 60% we should abort backfill and revert. abort flow: pause job, run migration-rollback, set DB read-only if needed. Agree?

mike: agree. also suggest lowering backfill concurrency if locks trend upward: `user_pref_fill --concurrency=2`

elaine: noted. abort checklist in runbook: pause job `redwood jobs pause <job_id>`, then rollback `redwood migrate rollback --tag=release-2026-03-21 --db=prod-db-01`. ops please be ready to flip DB to RO.

deploybot: Safety policy: automated rollback will only run after 3 manual confirmations from distinct approvers. To force immediate rollback use `/deploybot rollback 7250012345 --force` (ops/admins only).

laura: progress update: 16% rows done, no lock regression since canary change. reducing concurrency to 2 as precaution; latency stable.

ops-bot: alert cleared (pg_locks back under 25%). continuing to monitor.

mike: good signal. propose ramp to 25% in 10m if no new lock alerts.

sam: +1. holdpoint at 5% reached and healthy — proceed to 25% in 10m. I'll be watching for any lock spike >40%.

deploybot: Canary updated to 25%. Backfill re-targeted to shards 0-3. New backfill jobs spawned: ufb-20260321-09a..09d. Will wait for holdpoint verification.

laura: logging shard progress to ops channel. currently shard 0: 4% -> 12:03UTC next update.

elaine: release notes updated with migration caveats and revert steps. tagging infra and support for post-deploy watch: @infra @support.

sam: if we stay green for next 30m we can mark migration as complete and update release status.

mike: no regressions on canary traffic, locks stable. go/no-go leaning go.

deploybot: Holdpoint cleared by approvers: sam, mike, elaine. Automated rollout will finish remaining shards over next 40m.

elaine: final: release notes live, version pinned, rollback runbook linked. Thanks team — mark thread closed when final backfill finishes.

sam: thanks — monitoring until backfill job ids complete. will post final status.
